stage_rationale: The primary distinct Oracle with box IoU >= 0.25 did not pass its prespecified interval gate. The literal independent maximum-IoU Oracle with native fallback, stricter-IoU sensitivity, and GT-box geometry all support potential. Limit this exploratory mechanism check to the existing marked panel.
panel: The same 96 marker-order questions and 379 concrete choices. Use exactly the original displayed candidate sets, with up to eight per image.
models: Frozen HiSpatial-3B and the same aligned cached MoGe-2 pointmaps
positive_prompt: Does the highlighted region correspond to the object named {name}? Answer with only Yes or No.
complement_prompt: Is the highlighted region an object other than the one named {name}? Answer with only Yes or No.
score: First-token log p(Yes) minus log p(No), using canonical no-leading-space tokens. Keep the original RGB context and XYZ and mark exactly one region with the original first overlay color and no letters.
primary: Joint assignment using positive-prompt log odds, one choice per physical group, independently zero-scored rejection for each choice. Per-group score is the best matching member's log odds.
physical_groups: Connected components of overlapping fixed display masks, using the parent shortlist's strict IoU > 0.50 or containment > 0.65. No region is removed from scoring.

controls.individual: Raw positive likelihood ranking before rejection, then independent choice with zero-log-odds rejection
controls.complement: Reversed complement score and sign agreement. Joint readout with half the difference is diagnostic.
controls.swapped: Rotate concrete option names within each question by one fixed step and reassign those score rows to the original choices
controls.unrelated: Offline same-choice candidates with box IoU <= 0.05, paired against box IoU >= 0.25
controls.budget: The parent grouped control used 1462 logical model calls. Score the first three geometry-ranked marked proposals per concrete choice, and the fourth for 325 choices chosen by stable hash. Evaluate only the same 1462 positive score records. Record candidate exposure separately.

question_gate: Primary joint scoring must exceed the matched prior grouped 81/379 object hits at box IoU >= 0.25 and exceed its 0/96 all-concrete-correct questions. Only then evaluate the sealed geometric QA readout with the official scorer. Keep all rows and report the fixed controls.
data_access: Predict from sealed answer-free input only. Grade bindings after predictions and readouts are sealed. Use the official answer only in the final offline QA evaluation.
